records.title: Why does the form clear after I enter my employer’s name?
records.answer: Remove periods and commas from the employer name, keeping the name accurate, then re-enter any cleared fields and try again.
records.symptoms: Save and Next clears fields after you enter a company name with periods or commas.
records.explanation: A user confirmed firsthand that periods or commas in an employer name caused Save and Next to clear fields.
records.workaround: Keep a record of your original answer. Check all entries before retrying. If you consider removing punctuation, first confirm that the resulting name remains accurate. Ask official support when a legal name cannot be entered correctly.
records.caveats: Not a universal punctuation restriction. No silent substitutions or automatic name rewriting.

records.title: What should I enter when I choose OTHERS for religion?
records.answer: Enter your explanation in “If Others, Please specify,” or NA if not applicable, before continuing.
records.symptoms: The form resets or refuses to continue after Other is selected.
records.explanation: The official sample shows an “If Others, Please specify” prompt. A user confirmed firsthand that leaving the explanation empty caused the form to reset.
records.workaround: Fill the explanation before continuing. Enter NA if not applicable. Recheck the selection and explanation after a page refresh.
records.caveats: The user confirmed the conditional explanation field and use of NA in their session. Use NA only when it accurately applies.

records.title: Why did my selection disappear?
records.answer: Complete the form from top to bottom and recheck dropdowns and radio buttons after changing an earlier field.
records.symptoms: A radio button or dropdown returns to blank after the page changes.
records.explanation: A user confirmed firsthand that selecting dependent controls before completing earlier fields could cause those selections to clear.
records.workaround: Work from the top of the government page downward, then recheck every selection before saving.
records.caveats: This describes the user’s observed sequence; recheck selections after changing earlier fields.

records.title: Why are some fields blank after Save and Exit?
records.answer: After using Save and Exit on the official application, some fields may be blank when you return, so check your answers and fill in anything missing before continuing.
otherSources: User-reported Save and Exit behavior · 17 October 2026
records.symptoms: Fields or answers are cleared, blank or missing when you return to resume a saved application after Save and Exit.
records.explanation: The user reported that some fields may be cleared when returning to the official application after Save and Exit.
records.workaround: Check each section when reopening the application and fill in any missing answers before continuing.
records.caveats: The report does not identify every affected field or establish that this happens in every session.

records.title: Should I enter my ETA number or Application ID?
records.answer: For a previous Indian e-Visa, enter the ETA number from the issued document in the previous visa field, not the Application ID.
records.symptoms: You cannot tell which number belongs in the previous visa field.
records.explanation: ETA means Electronic Travel Authorization. For a previous Indian e-Visa, the ETA number is the previous visa number. The Application ID tracks the application.
records.workaround: Enter the ETA number from your previously issued e-Visa. For a regular visa, enter the visa number printed on the document.
records.caveats: Copy the number from the issued document, keeping its letters and digits intact.

records.title: What is the place of issue for my previous visa?
records.answer: Enter New Delhi for a previous Indian e-Visa, or the place printed on your visa for a regular visa.
records.symptoms: You arrived through one airport but applied online.
records.explanation: For a previous Indian e-Visa, you can enter New Delhi as the place of issue.
records.workaround: Enter New Delhi for a previous e-Visa. For a regular visa, use the place of issue printed on the visa.
records.caveats: The place of issue is separate from your arrival airport.

records.title: Why is my arrival airport listed under a different name?
records.answer: Search Port of Arrival by city, airport name or code to find the matching label, including alternate names such as Trivandrum and Thiruvananthapuram.
records.symptoms: Your ticket’s city name differs from the arrival dropdown.
records.explanation: The live registration dropdown observed on 17 October 2026 contains 86 choices. Our arrival selector searches those exact labels plus separately sourced names and airport codes. Multiple names for one port share a result; different ports in one city remain separate.
records.workaround: Use the airport finder to compare aliases and the observed dropdown label, then check the choice in your current form. Verify authorized entry separately on the official portal.
records.caveats: Dropdown presence is not proof of authorized entry or eligibility. Choices may change with your session.

records.title: How do I split an address across the fields?
records.answer: Use your accommodation’s address in the matching street, city, state or district and PIN fields, treating Gurgaon and Gurugram as the same city.
records.symptoms: Your accommodation address has several place names.
records.explanation: Some places have multiple names: Gurgaon and Gurugram refer to the same city in Haryana. Older and newer names can appear in addresses and dropdowns. City, district and state are separate parts of an address.
records.workaround: Use the full address supplied by your accommodation. Put the street/locality in the address lines and the city, district, state and PIN in their corresponding fields. If a dropdown uses an alternate name, select the matching place.
records.caveats: A city name alone does not identify a street’s PIN code. Keep the PIN supplied with the full address.

records.title: What if I don’t have a National ID number?
records.answer: Enter your national identity number if you have one, or NA if it does not apply. Americans, for example, do not have national ID numbers and should specify “NA”.
records.symptoms: You are unsure what number to enter or whether you have one.
records.explanation: This field asks for a national identity number. Enter NA when it does not apply; U.S. applicants without a national ID can use NA.
records.workaround: Enter your applicable national identity number, or NA if you do not have one.
otherSources: U.S. applicant NA guidance confirmed by the user · 17 October 2026
records.caveats: Enter a number or NA here; your nationality belongs in the separate nationality field.

records.title: Why does my file still say “Not Uploaded”?
records.answer: After choosing the file, click Upload Photo or Upload Document and check that the uploaded preview appears before continuing.
records.symptoms: A selected filename appears but the official site still says Not Uploaded.
records.explanation: Choosing a file and uploading it are separate steps. After selecting your file, use the displayed Upload Photo or Upload Document action.
records.workaround: On the official site, select the prepared file, perform the displayed upload action, and inspect its status and preview before continuing.
records.caveats: Before continuing, make sure the file status shows it has uploaded and the preview displays the correct file. This companion never performs the upload.

records.title: What file types and sizes do I need?
records.answer: Use a square JPEG photo of 10 KB–1 MB and at least 350 × 350 pixels, and a passport biodata PDF of 10–300 KB.
records.symptoms: A photo or passport scan is rejected for format or file size.
records.explanation: Prepare a square JPEG photo of 10 KB–1 MB and at least 350 × 350 pixels. Prepare the passport biodata page as a PDF of 10–300 KB.
records.workaround: Use the local file tools, inspect the full-size output, and check the current upload screen. Your face must be clear and the passport text and machine-readable lines legible.
records.caveats: Passing technical bounds cannot establish visual quality or official acceptance. HEIC/HEIF decoding runs locally; damaged or unsupported files need a fresh JPEG/PNG export.

records.title: What if I was charged but payment is still pending?
records.answer: Allow up to two hours for the status to update, then use Verify Payment / Pay e-Visa Fee on the official portal before trying another payment.
records.symptoms: The bank shows a charge but the government status is pending.
records.explanation: The official instructions say payment status updates can take up to two hours.
records.workaround: Wait for the stated update period and use Verify Payment / Pay e-Visa Fee on the official portal before attempting another payment or application. Contact the official helpdesk if unresolved.
records.caveats: We do not process payments or collect payment details. Recheck current official instructions.
